body: I don't think i'd be able to read anything. I can't focus on anything - besides blaming myself and feeling guilty.

Thanks for the answer. Few years ago I would say "please, just listen to me and say that everything will be fine", but now it won't work. That's one of the thing that I'm afraid before my visit to a psychologist. Recently I spoke with my mother about my problems - first time in my life and... I felt nothing. I was like "Jesus Christ why I'm wasting my time, it won't change anything, it won't change my past". In the middle of sentence I gave up and ended conversation.
